checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals segmentation-logic, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals segmentation-logic.

checks.description: The logic defines an entry trigger and the engagement branches (opened, clicked, not-opened).
checks.rule: Body and output define entry_trigger and branch conditions for openers, clickers, and non-openers.

checks.description: Non-openers get a subject-line retry, not a louder pitch.
checks.rule: Body states non-openers receive a subject-line retry rather than a louder or more aggressive pitch.

checks.description: Segment sizes are resolved from live data and never invented.
checks.rule: Body states segment sizes come from the data or are resolved at send time, and forbids inventing a size.

checks.description: Suppression excludes paying contacts, unsubscribes, and hard bounces, stated explicitly with a source.
checks.rule: Output suppression field names paying contacts, unsubscribed, and hard-bounced, with the source confirmed at build; suppression is not optional.

checks.description: A sunset rule and engagement-decay suppression are defined: after roughly 90 to 180 days with no open or click, or 3 to 4 attempts, run a 1 to 3 email sunset then suppress.
checks.rule: Body and output define a sunset_rule with an engagement-decay condition (no open or click in roughly 90 to 180 days, or 3 to 4 attempts), a 1 to 3 email sunset flow, then suppress, framed as deliverability and consent or PDPL hygiene; the window is not invented.

checks.description: Hard rule present: no personal or sensitive data in a tracking URL parameter.
checks.rule: Hard rules state no personal or sensitive data in a tracking URL parameter.

checks.description: Inter-message timing is kept inside the brief send window.
checks.rule: Body states inter-message delays stay inside the send window from the brief.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash character, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals.
